subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-104.draft.md
summary: The schema-successor recording is substantively bounded and every dispatched attack except one provenance defect fails. The draft cites D-103 as an existing same-form decision even though the draft's own pinned COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md bytes contain no D-103 entry. The adopted D-013/D-015/D-035/D-042 precedents already support the form, so this is a one-token SHOULD-FIX rather than a MUST-FIX. With 0 MUST-FIX and 1 SHOULD-FIX, the CONSENT gate is not met.

should_fix.title: The decision-type header cites unadopted D-103 as an operative form precedent
should_fix.measurement: At the draft-cited COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md digest 12d192f758f48f692e69cb410a1d7a9bf776c765257c8e910272d3de457ec3e3, an exact heading search for '^## D-103\b' returns zero entries. Under D-000, that register is where adopted decisions are documented. D-103 is also absent from the measured-input table, so the header has neither an adopted decision nor a pinned non-operative draft behind the unqualified citation.
should_fix.why_should_fix_not_must_fix: The false precedent is non-load-bearing: operative decision item 1 cites only D-013/D-015/D-035/D-042, all four are adopted, and D-013/D-035/D-042 directly establish the needed accepted-contract-with-advisories/OPEN/no-SATISFIED form. Removing D-103 changes no authority or outcome. It should still be fixed because a D-000 decision header must not present an in-flight or nonexistent decision as adopted provenance.
should_fix.minimum_repair: Delete ' / D-103' from line 8. If D-103 is intended as a dependency, instead state that dependency expressly, require D-103 adoption first, and refresh the COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md pin after it lands.

attack_results.attack: Silent SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, blueprint, or implementation authorization
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 3 keeps DR-103 OPEN and says 'No SATISFIED' (lines 43-48). Item 4 denies blueprint and docs/v2/implementation authorization (lines 49-50). The SATISFIED and application alternatives are rejected at lines 60-63, readiness effect is zero at line 69, and nothing claims QUALIFIED.

attack_results.attack: Treats advisories as blockers or pretends they do not exist
attack_results.evidence: Lines 24-28 disambiguate all three advisory identities; decision item 2 names and carries all three as successor honesty work without treating them as blockers (lines 39-42); lines 57-59 state that advisories travel.

attack_results.attack: Collapses Claude V11-A1 with Codex V11-A1
attack_results.evidence: The draft accurately distinguishes Claude's citationDiscipline/whatThisDoesNotDo duplication as CLAUDE-V11-A1 from Codex's corpusAdvance-on-OD-2 finding as CODEX-V11-A1, and separately names CLAUDE-V11-A2 (lines 24-28). The live verdict texts confirm these are three distinct advisories.

attack_results.attack: Claims a lock is now producible
attack_results.evidence: Line 46 says no lock is producible and lines 60-62 retain the DR-111 deferral. The v11 source's ID-DEP-4 says no lock of any form is producible until DR-111 closes; live file 08 still marks DR-111 OPEN. The accepted-schema recording does not alter either gate.

attack_results.attack: Opens D-056 Class A or SATISFIED while the fixture corpus is unmet
attack_results.evidence: Lines 43-48 keep the fixture-corpus half unmet, preserve D-013's SATISFIED-refusal, and expressly say D-056 Class A is not opened because the remainder is not only execution/measurement. Live D-056 specifically keeps DR-103 ineligible and says D-013's refusal stands until fixture authoring exists.
Decision item 4 expressly says it does not edit file 08 (line 49). The live file remained at the cited digest, with DR-103 OPEN and its fixture-corpus half unsatisfied.

attack_results.attack: Misstates the adopted D-013/D-035/D-042 recording form
attack_results.result: REFUTED FOR THE ADOPTED PRECEDENTS; D-103 CITATION SEPARATELY SUSTAINED AS D104-SF-1
attack_results.evidence: D-013 records an accepted DR-103 design contract, keeps the row OPEN on the corpus half, and adds zero SATISFIED. D-035 records ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES, treats advisories as non-blockers, keeps its row OPEN, and makes no SATISFIED/freeze motion. D-042 records an accepted design-contract candidate, carries advisories, keeps its row OPEN, edits neither file 08 nor freeze, and adds zero SATISFIED. D-104's operative effect matches these.

attack_results.attack: The two schema verdicts were not 0-blocker / 0-SHOULD-FIX
attack_results.evidence: Claude verdict 45785457b25e50e51be7f3a1393427de637022752a9af70b38e87ecb79ce0f20 is ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES with blockers=[] and shouldFix=[], carrying two advisories. Codex verdict 25b2a3fb0200cab5132b333543a708c3bfb024e1fab11b9751c44696e52b1372 is ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES with blockers=[] and shouldFix=[], carrying one advisory. Draft lines 17-18 report these exactly.

attack_results.attack: Retargets corpus v2 or opens SATISFIED-GRADE review against it
attack_results.evidence: Lines 44-46 retain corpus v2 at digest 70248781... against schemas.v9 and decline SATISFIED-GRADE. Lines 51-53 prohibit retargeting and sequence any new corpus v3 after adoption; lines 64-65 reject v2 retargeting. The live corpus v2 digest reproduces, its schemaContract targets schemas.v9, and its reviewStatus remains DRAFT-AWAITING-SCHEMA-SUCCESSOR.

attack_results.attack: Overturns D-013 or loses the historical v2 recording
attack_results.evidence: Lines 30-31 retain D-013 as the historical schemas.v2 recording and expressly decline to overturn it. Decision item 3 preserves D-013's SATISFIED-refusal.

attack_results.attack: Invents a D-096(A) grant or disposes DR-117
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 5 denies both effects verbatim (line 51). Live D-097 leaves D-096(A) unsatisfied pending an express user grant; the draft claims no such authority.

attack_results.attack: Confuses decision D-104 with register row DR-104
attack_results.evidence: The title and overturn token use decision identifier D-104, while every operative row reference is DR-103. The draft never claims to decide or alter register row DR-104.

attack_results.evidence: All five pins reproduce exactly: schemas.v11 1c0b8868444a097256aaa7d9caf8ebaa1c6f73fb071dbb4dd712334abb17a005; Claude verdict 45785457b25e50e51be7f3a1393427de637022752a9af70b38e87ecb79ce0f20; Codex verdict 25b2a3fb0200cab5132b333543a708c3bfb024e1fab11b9751c44696e52b1372; COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md 12d192f758f48f692e69cb410a1d7a9bf776c765257c8e910272d3de457ec3e3; file 08 1cdcf9d4071a6c5eaa7cd7d28fac288eaced796c9ee906b6f1db0f7a4b1f95b3.
